message.content: {"class":"INSUFFICIENT_DATA","reasoning":"The timeout tie-break makes a bare timeout with no other evidence insufficient to classify; the SocketTimeoutException establishes only that a read timed out. ENVIRONMENT_CONFIG and PRODUCT_DEFECT remain possible, as does TEST_CODE_DEFECT if the test's limit was too short; the deciding evidence is the server-side log for the request showing whether it arrived and when it completed."}
